description: Look up products by retail barcode: UPC-12, EAN-13 or GTIN-14. Use when the user gives a numeric product barcode (from a shelf tag, an invoice, a supplier price list, a wholesale catalog) and wants to know which Amazon or Walmart listing it maps to — e.g. 'what is UPC 050875825598 on Amazon', 'match these barcodes to ASINs'. Returns the matched products (best match first — priced and recently observed rows lead) with ASIN, brand, title, price, rating and image. One barcode per call.

barcode.description: The numeric barcode (UPC-12 / EAN-13 / GTIN-14; 8-14 digits).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

name: lookup_product_by_barcode
